footer.about: Greenway Exteriors is a locally owned exterior remodeling company in Wichita, serving homeowners since 2012. We replace windows and siding and handle doors, gutters, trim and paint.
why: Owner John Dye on every estimate
A straight price for what the job needs
Windows and siding from one crew
Your customers love you: all 87 of your Google reviews are five stars, and they praise an honest price, an owner who answers his phone and crews that clean up.

Your site already does a lot right: a page for every service, a page for each town and fast loading. But it leads with siding while windows are just as big in your reviews, it hides your number on a phone, and it makes two claims BBB does not back.
So we rebuilt it around what your customers say, with John up front and a one-tap call at the top.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and how the demo fixes it.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: On a phone, the top of your homepage is a financing bar, your logo and a photo. What you do and your number sit a full screen down, so visitors leave before they call.
The headline names two services and never says what kind of company you are, and siding comes first while windows and doors are about 44% of your written reviews.
The page says "over 15 years" and your siding page says "since 2012". BBB shows 14 years, so anyone who checks sees two answers.
fixes: Your number is one tap at the very top.
A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS, with windows and siding given equal weight.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Windows and doors are about 44% of your written reviews, and this page is where a homeowner decides to trust you.
problems: The "CALL" line at the top is plain text, so a visitor on a phone cannot tap it.
The page says "BBB accreditation", but BBB lists you as not accredited. A careful buyer can check that in a minute.
On a phone your window pages run 11 to 19 screens long.
fixes: A page for window replacement in Wichita, KS, with your number one tap away.
Only claims a homeowner can check.
One page for one window, a whole house, basement windows and doors, with a review beside each.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Siding Replacement
cards.why: Siding and trim are about 45% of your written reviews, and your crews finish them in days.
problems: Nine siding pages sit in your menu, so a visitor picks a material before seeing what the job costs. Your reviews talk about price, crews and clean-up.
"Gutters" in your menu opens the homepage instead of a page.
fixes: One siding page for a full re-side, a single wall, chimneys, trim and repairs.
Reviews on price, long days and clean yards, where a buyer is deciding.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: The page where interest turns into a call.
problems: Your hours read "Monday-Sunday, 24 Hours", which sounds like template text, so visitors cannot tell when John picks up.
Your form is protected only by a hidden field, with no spam blocker.
fixes: Your number and address together, with what to have ready.
No hours claim until you give us your real ones.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.
